caveat: Own fit to raw transmission data. Held-out transmission (EXFOR 32234004) chi2/pt 2.60 vs ENDF/B-VIII.1 2.99. Two of five EXFOR sets were dropped by the pre-registered admission rule (13759005: 6 % low below 300 eV; 13727003: thick sample, 2 % low). Fitted R' is poorly determined (3.0 +- 1.2 fm). A dip near 131 eV in two sets is a Co-59 sample impurity and is not drawn. Thermal free-atom elastic 12.33 b vs 12.42 +- 0.39 b measured. The 1 keV join average (800-1200 eV) includes the ENDF/B-VIII.1 carrier above 1 keV with its 1.15 keV capture resonance, so join.ratio 1.76 says nothing about this fit (our capture at 1 keV is 0.0082 b). STRUCTRRR final report (2026-10-27): PASS; OpenMC gate v3 PASS; advisory DEV k-eff changes not resolved (|dk| <~ 2 sigma). In the hybrid library lib_res_v0 as PROVISIONAL.
caveat_short: own fit; held-out transmission better than ENDF/B-VIII.1 (chi2/pt 2.60 vs 2.99)
